spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down
spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I'm Ewan Pemberton. The app was down when I tried to pay my electricity bill, and now I've been charged a late fee. I'm really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry that's happened, Ewan. I can see a £25 late-payment fee on your account, and I promise we'll get that money returned to you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Well, that's good, but the bill was due on Monday and I couldn't get the app to work at all.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. Before I look into it further, I need to verify you. Could you tell me your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that's verified. I'll log this as a complaint about the app outage and the late fee. Your reference is TB-684219.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Thanks. I don't really understand online banking, to be honest. My son normally does it for me, but he wasn't around.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That's completely understandable, and I'm sorry you were left stuck. I can ask our Financial Support team to call you and talk through using the app, or we can discuss extra time for bills if you need it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: A call from them would be helpful. I don't want this happening again.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I'll refer you to the Financial Support team today, and I'll personally call you by 3 pm tomorrow to confirm the referral and update you on the complaint.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. What happens with the complaint now?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: We'll investigate the app outage and the fee, then send you a full written response within 8 weeks. I've logged it today, and I'll be your point of contact until I call tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right, so you'll refer me for help today, call tomorrow by three, and the written response will come within eight weeks?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That's right. I've noted all of that. Does that make sense, and is there anything else you'd like me to explain?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No, that makes sense. Thank you.
